g.text: North Chattanooga lattice. Blue BLUFOR, orange
OPFOR, grey neutral; green ring = spawnable.
Living leader is a spawn point; leader damage
denies it 8 s - countdown or opaque (flag).
List mirrors map picks; enemy-held rows are
disabled. DEPLOY locks class + spawn choice.
Class row: Assault / Medic / Support / Recon
4 kit buttons, 44px min touch target. Selected
kit persists across deaths until changed.
Both team tickets live at top. Spawns release
in shared waves; countdown shows next window.
Same flow stacked: map, class row, spawn chips,
full-width DEPLOY. All targets 44px or larger.
